items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: Wade, yeah, he was unclarated at that time. ... And when he left Ory, he went out on the boat. ... But that time, Wade had come back and started playing with Ory. ... they all hooked up together and made the band up over again

ctx.x: Was Wade unclarated at that time?
Wade, yeah, he was unclarated at that time.
Yeah. You remember when Johnny Dodds came in the band or did Punch play with Ory too, didn't he a while?
